why: A June 2025 arXiv paper by Mozhui and Krishna directly addresses the conjecture that crown graphs H_{n,n} have the highest representation number among bipartite graphs, proving it for all cases except partite sets of equal even size, i.e. a partial resolution of exactly this problem.
